stem: A coworker suggests opening an energized electrical control panel to troubleshoot a repeated alarm, but the technician is not authorized for electrical service. What should the Technician II do?
choices: Open it because senior technicians can repair anything
Stay within permitted checks, make the system safe as defined by SOP, and escalate to qualified maintenance
Reset every breaker until the alarm clears
rationale: Technician II has stronger equipment-verification responsibility but does not override electrical safety or authorization boundaries.
